supportedProtocol.query: one named subject and one positive relation family
supportedProtocol.unknown: requested subject or requested relation absent, or only negated matching evidence

scoring.primary: Exact match after Unicode NFC normalization and stripping leading/trailing Unicode whitespace only. Case, internal whitespace, punctuation and all other characters remain exact.
scoring.acceptedAnswers: A prediction is correct iff normalized prediction equals at least one normalized acceptedAnswers entry. No post-hoc alternatives may be added.
scoring.outputContract: Return a full supporting evidence sentence verbatim or exactly UNBEKANNT. Partial spans, added explanation, concatenated sentences and UNBEKANNT with added punctuation fail unless explicitly listed.
metrics: non-UNBEKANNT outputs not equal to any complete evidence sentence, diagnostic only
scoring.challengeReporting: Eight challenges have a separate denominator and per-case categories. They must never be included in the supported32 pass rate. C04 accepts either full support or abstention and must be reported as a multiple-valid-support challenge.
scoring.diagnosticMeaning: An exact source copy is measured extraction, not independent fact verification or general intelligence.
scoring.execution: Each case gets a fresh independent generation with no previous-case history. Pass only instruction, evidence and question to the model. Never pass id, authorLabel, stratum, relationFamily, acceptedAnswers or evaluator notes.
freezeBeforeEvaluation: deterministic decoding settings, resource and token ceilings
scoring.noTuning: Do not inspect candidate outputs before fixture freeze; do not tune weights, prompts, thresholds, decoding, tokenizer or code on this TEST. Any correction after reading results consumes this TEST and requires a new independent holdout.

shuffle.algorithm: Fisher-Yates descending, LCG state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod 2^32, j=state mod(i+1)
